extra: bulbs go out only at 10.0, 12.0 and 13.0 and stay out (bulbs 4-5 stay lit, 6 flickers from 8.0)

(()=>{const ctx=window.__ctx;const B=ctx.procs;let bad=[];const outAt=[10.0,12.0,13.0];for(let f=0;f<450;f++){const t=f/30;window.renderAt(t);document.querySelectorAll('.bulbs').forEach((g,gi)=>{[...g.querySelectorAll(':scope > g')].forEach((b,i)=>{const fill=b.children[2].getAttribute('fill').toUpperCase();const lit=fill==='#FFD27B';const out=fill==='#544174';if(i<3){const shouldOut=t>=outAt[i];if(shouldOut&&!out)bad.push(`f${f} bulb${i+1} not out`);if(!shouldOut&&!lit)bad.push(`f${f} bulb${i+1} not lit`);}else if(i<5){if(!lit)bad.push(`f${f} bulb${i+1} dim`);}else{const want=t<8?true:(Math.floor((t-8)*4)%2===0);if(lit!==want&&!(fill!=='#FFD27B'&&!want))bad.push(`f${f} bulb6 flicker`);}});});}return{ok:bad.length===0,msg:bad.length?bad.slice(0,6).join(', '):'checked 450 frames x 2 strings'}})()

(()=>{let bad=[];for(let f=0;f<450;f+=1){const t=f/30;window.renderAt(t);const on=window.__meta.subs.some(s=>t>=s.t0&&t<s.t1);if(!on)continue;document.querySelectorAll('.bulbs').forEach(g=>{const r=g.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width&&r.bottom>0&&r.top<1920&&r.right>0&&r.left<1080&&r.top<460)bad.push('f'+f+' top '+r.top.toFixed(0));});}return{ok:bad.length===0,msg:bad.length?bad.slice(0,6).join(', '):'bulb strings stay below y=460 whenever a SUB is on'}})()
